title: Android client: native kith app for Android
description:
A native Android client for kith. Connects to the user's own kithd over their Tailscale network via JMAP over HTTPS. No central server; the app is just a UI to the user's mailbox.

Scope:
- Tailscale SDK or companion app integration to reach the user's tailnet from the phone
- JMAP session bootstrap from /.well-known/jmap on the user's kithd
- Contact list, chat list, message thread (1:1 and group)
- Send/receive messages; read receipts via Peer/receipt
- Attachment upload (camera, files) and download
- EventSource or long-poll for push (FCM as wakeup mechanism, poll for content — kithd has no FCM knowledge)
- Background sync when app is in background (WorkManager or foreground service)
- Notifications for new messages
- Target: Kotlin + Jetpack Compose; Material3 design language
- Distribution: Google Play Store
